race.comment: ANDREA (8) savaged the line first-up in the heavy going with an unlucky second over 1100m at this track in Highway grade. Clearly come back in great order and gets the benefit of Llewellyn's claim again. Adept in all conditions and can go one better. GATWICK (4) fifth-up for this and has the speed to get over from the sticky gate. Three weeks between runs on the heavy track when she went under narrowly to run second over 1200m at Canterbury. Drops sharply in weight and assess on the slick Maiden win two-back. KWIRKY SMILE (10) heavily supported into favouritism second-up with a dominant win from back in the field over 1200m at Gosford on the heavy (9) track. Looks up to this on the limit. EMBRACE THE WIND (3) eye-catching performance when third over the 1300m here in this class. Ready for this trip and stays in the calculations. ERNAUX (5) gets one more chance on the firmer surface with the 54.5kg.
